subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the alternatives: 1 7=7
stimulus: i. Where does Meherjan live after losing her home? a) On a boat in the Jamuna River b) In a slum on the Sirajgonj Town Protection Embankment c) In a refugee camp in Dhaka d) In a government shelter ii. What does the "whispering wind" and "dancing flames" symbolize in Meherjan’s life? a) Her connection to nature b) Her past happiness c) The instability and turmoil in her life d) The upcoming monsoon season iii. What natural disaster is responsible for Meherjan’s suffering? a) Cyclone b) Earthquake c) River erosion d) Tsunami iv. How long did it take for the river to destroy Meherjan’s last shelter? a) A month b) A week c) A day d) A year v. What happened to Meherjan’s family members? a) They moved to a different village b) They died from hunger and poverty-related diseases c) They were rescued by the government d) They started a new business elsewhere vi. Which of the following rivers is NOT mentioned as a cause of erosion in Bangladesh? a) The Jamuna b) The Padma c) The Meghna d) The Brahmaputra vii. How many people are estimated to become homeless due to river erosion every year in Bangladesh? a) 50,000 b) 75,000 c) 100,000 d) 200,000
